wishText: Happy Valentine bub , you're special to me. No matter what the future brings, i know that everything will be okay. I am happiest when we are together. I may not know what tomorrow will bring, but i believe that we will be alright 🤍. You are like a light that shines bright, you are a star in the night sky. Whereever we go tomorrow, it will be really great as long as you are with me. Happy valentine darling 🤍🤍
